accounting.required: Exactly expected model and all four usage fields finite and nonnegative; no fill, no result.usage fallback, no summing toolUseResult child metadata.

evaluation.quality_gate: Original seven q001 criteria unchanged: at least8 points, C1-C3 full credit, valid core citations, zero critical contradictions.
evaluation.review: Blinded final-answer source review; no labels, resource totals or trajectories in grader packet. Structural reward is not quality.
evaluation.execution_validity: Terminal success, expected identities, final text agrees with native ATIF/persisted root, source/runtime checks, complete structural tool/child linkage, no-web/source-only audit. Usage-only defects do not alone invalidate an answer.
evaluation.quality_candidate: Both execution-valid; zg passes original quality gate and baseline fails, zg factual points >= baseline, at least one actual successful relevant correct-workspace zg retrieval.
evaluation.reported_input_candidate: Both execution-valid and quality-pass; zg factual points >= baseline; both reported aggregates available without contradictory complete evidence; zg primary reported input strictly below baseline; at least one successful relevant correct-workspace zg retrieval. Label explicitly as a reported-input development candidate, with corroboration status.
evaluation.c6_consistency: Prospective host-only grader contract resolves compound handling-errors primary requirement symmetrically; minimal-lifecycle reading retained as separate sensitivity, never replaces primary after outcome.

stopping.after_pair: Stop after exact two slots. Any confirmation requires separately frozen decision. No task/prompt tweak, resampling or automatic expansion in this phase.
stopping.on_invalid: Retain scheduled partial/failed results. Attempt each profile at most once in fixed order unless cleanup fails; no whole-trial retries or replacements.
stopping.goal: A single favorable pair cannot establish a favorable benchmark set.

runtime.wall: Report native agent wall, audited source/log collection overhead, Harbor setup timestamps and measured full slot separately. Native agent wall retains query embedding latency.
